predictions.rationale: Central domain entity that models the lifecycle of an order, including creation, status transitions (stock confirmation, payment, shipping, cancellation) and related invariants.
Public HTTP API that clients use to create, cancel, and query orders; orchestrates the full ordering workflow.
Enumeration/value object defining the possible states of an order (submitted, awaiting validation, stock confirmed, paid, shipped, cancelled).
Application-layer handler that executes the creation of a new order at checkout, invoking domain logic and persisting the result.
Handles the cancellation command, updating order status and publishing related domain events.
Updates an order after stock validation, a key step in tracking order progression.
Transitions an order to the paid state once payment succeeds, integral to order tracking.
Handles shipment command, moving the order to shipped status and completing the fulfillment pipeline.
Read-model queries that fetch order details and current status for tracking purposes.
Service that publishes integration events reflecting order status changes (stock confirmed, paid, shipped, cancelled) to other bounded contexts.
